integrity: The infinite claims follow from explicit cellwise Bernoulli variance, exact finite power sums and primitive lattice counting; finite rational tests are supplementary, not certification. No external scientific audit has occurred.
limitations: Fixed coprime integer a,b and 0<c<a; square-grid independent one-point-per-cell jitter. No claims for general irrational slopes, altered threshold regimes or different partitions; publication priority remains subject to specialist review.
title: An exact quartic grid-phase law for oblique half-plane jittered quadrature
